info.description: API Rest interactiva y pública para el proyecto Anirank.
info.title: Anirank API

post.description: Create a new Anime (Post) in the database.

put.description: Update an existing Anime by ID.

delete.description: Delete an existing Anime by ID.

post.description: Create a new Artist in the database.

put.description: Update an existing Artist by ID.

delete.description: Delete an existing Artist by ID.

get.description: Admin endpoint to list all unresolved reports.

put.description: Admin endpoint to mark a report as resolved.

post.description: Create a new Song in the database. Optionally sync Artist relationships.

put.description: Update an existing Song by ID. Optionally sync Artist relationships.

delete.description: Delete an existing Song by ID.

get.description: Admin endpoint to list all unresolved user requests.

put.description: Admin endpoint to mark a specific user request as resolved.

post.description: Create a new Song Variant (video/audio link) in the database.

put.description: Update an existing Song Variant by ID.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all Animes ordered by default index rules.
Retrieves all data associated with an Anime, including related songs and variants based on its slug.
Fetch paginated root comments for a specific entity (e.g. Song).

post.description: Create a new comment or a reply to an existing comment.

delete.description: Delete an existing comment by ID.

get.description: Fetch paginated replies for a specific parent comment.
Loads essential taxonomy and lookup arrays required for the SPA context (Years, Seasons, Formats, etc).

post.description: Toggle the favorite status of a Song or Playlist for the authenticated user.

get.description: Retrieve the latest ratings, reactions, and favorites across the platform.

post.description: Submit a rating (1-10) for a specific Song.
Submit a reaction (1 for like, -1 for dislike, 0 to clear) for a SongVariant or Comment.
Authenticates a user with email and password, returning a JWT.
Create a new playlist for the authenticated user.

get.description: Fetch paginated playlists for a user.
Fetch details of a playlist including attached songs.

put.description: Update an existing playlist by ID.

delete.description: Delete an existing playlist by ID.

post.description: Append or insert a song at a given position within a playlist.

put.description: Update the sort order of songs within a custom playlist.

delete.description: Remove a specific song from a user's playlist.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's profile information.

post.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password.
Submit a report for an entity (User, Song, Comment, etc) as a user.

get.description: Search across Animes, Songs, Artists, and Users using a single query term.
Fetch the active tournament and its current matchups/bracket.

post.description: Submit a vote for a specific song in an ongoing tournament matchup.

get.description: Fetch a specific tournament's details and matchups by its slug.

post.description: Submit a general support request (E.g request an Artist to be added).

video_src.description: Embedded Video Info to simulate 1:1 legacy relation without join overhead

song_b_id.description: Nulable if waiting or got a bye
